messages.subject: Need your call on the Apollo indemnity clause before 3pm
messages.snippet:
Hey Alex,

Sorry to do this on short notice. Legal is holding the Apollo contract on one open point and they need our answer before the 3pm signing call.

The question: do we accept Apollo's mutual in
messages.body:
Hey Alex,

Sorry to do this on short notice. Legal is holding the Apollo contract on one open point and they need our answer before the 3pm signing call.

The question: do we accept Apollo's mutual indemnity cap at one year of fees, or do we push for the unlimited carve-out on data-breach liability like we did with Meridian?

I'm fine either way but I can't make the call alone. Can you reply with which way you want me to go? Just need a yes/no on the unlimited carve-out.

Thanks,
Jordan
messages.bodyHtml:
Jordan Rivera

colleague@example.com
